goal: Expose the existing global external AI consent to admins and let streamers edit identical or separate platform metadata.
boundaries: Reuse existing admin authorization, CSRF protection and settings persistence with updated_by.
Keep the existing per-video, per-platform metadata storage and save endpoint.
acceptance: GET and PUT global external AI consent reject non-admin sessions and PUT requires CSRF.
The admin social AI processing settings can enable and disable the global consent.
Streamer copy explains that an admin must enable external AI first, with an English translation.
Identical stored metadata defaults to shared mode; different metadata defaults to separate mode.
Shared editing saves identical values for every platform and validates every platform's limits.
Changing from shared to separate preserves current values.
Affected Rust and frontend checks pass; inspect Moli screenshots at 390 and 1440 pixels.
Merge and push main only after ALLOW from the local review gate.
